SASBDB entry SASDCM5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDCM5/)

Publication: The vaccinia virus DNA polymerase structure provides insights into the mode of processivity factor binding.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-017-01542-z

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDCM5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.

q cut (round 9, 2026-11-13): the script fits q <= 0.25 A^-1 and leaves out the noise tail: S/N below 2 beyond about 0.2; above the cut 86 of 522 points non-positive (first at 0.214), mean I/sigma 0.95; the depositor's fit ends at 0.2504 but that is not the reason.
Every other entry without such a tail is fitted over its whole curve.
